findings.title: The till line names no till or card reader and nothing compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now

location.description: the "Works with your till" line under the table

findings.viewer_experience: An owner whose till or card reader is not named assumes it is not supported. Nothing tells them why Shelfmark beats walking the shelves on Monday or reading the till's own sales report.

current.value: The line says "Works with your till. Sales come in from the shop's card reader as they happen." It names no till or card reader and no line compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now.

findings.target: The line names the supported tills or card readers, and one line compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now. The maker must supply both facts.
findings.fix_direction: The maker names the supported tills or card readers and adds one line that compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now. Only the maker has these facts, so do not invent them.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images that the till line names the supported tills or card readers and that one line compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now.

findings.title: Nothing answers the Pricing and "Shops using it" links, and the bottom third of the screen is blank

location.description: the empty area below the fact lines

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor who wants to know the price has to click away, and the page looks like it stops early.

current.value: Content ends at about y=528 of 800 on desktop and about y=528 of 1080 on widescreen. No pricing section and no section about shops exists.

findings.target: A short section on pricing and on the shops that use it sits below the fact lines. The maker must supply the pricing facts and the facts about the shops.
findings.fix_direction: Add a short section on pricing and on the shops that use it, below the fact lines. The maker must supply the pricing facts and the facts about the shops; do not invent them.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees in the desktop and widescreen images a short section on pricing and on the shops that use it below the fact lines, and the empty area is gone.

findings.title: On the tablet the fact lines wrap well inside the width of the table above

location.description: the fact lines under the table on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: A wide empty strip is left on the right of the fact lines.

current.value: The fact lines wrap at about 340 px while the table above is 600 px wide.

findings.target: The fact lines run nearer to the width of the table, and no last line holds one or two words.
findings.fix_direction: Let the lines run nearer to the width of the table, and check again that no last line holds one or two words.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees in the tablet image that the fact lines run nearer to the width of the table and that no last line holds one or two words.
